# Edmonton Refreshed Seating

Edmonton Refreshed is a curated pre-owned furniture dealer based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. The business specializes in quality sofas and sectionals from recognized brands — B&B Italia, Natuzzi, Rove Concepts, Crate & Barrel, EQ3, West Elm, American Leather, Restoration Hardware, La-Z-Boy, Urban Barn, and Brentwood Classics. All pieces are professionally inspected, cleaned, and available for viewing by appointment in Edmonton.

## What We Do

**Buying side:** Edmonton Refreshed buys pre-owned sofas and sectionals outright from sellers in Edmonton and the surrounding area. Sellers submit photos and details; a firm offer is made the same day. Pickup is handled at no cost to the seller.

**Selling side:** Available inventory is sold B2C at prices well below retail. Delivery is available anywhere in Edmonton and surrounding communities (St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Fort Saskatchewan).
